attributes.title: 2027 IPA Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Indiana Pharmacists Association holds its 2027 Annual Meeting on March 4 and 5, 2027, at the Ritz Charles Conference Center in Carmel, just north of Indianapolis. The meeting brings together pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and student pharmacists from across the state.

IPA is accredited by ACPE as a provider of continuing pharmacy education, and the meeting page states that CE credit is available for both pharmacists and technicians, with some sessions run by the association's Technician Council. Unless a session is marked otherwise, presentations carry CPE credit; attendees sign in, attend each activity and complete the online evaluation within a week.

The total number of contact hours and the registration fees were not published yet when we checked, and parts of the agenda were still marked as coming soon.
